## Validation

- Contract and relevant behavior tests:

- Vehicle test record or explicit untested limitation:

Confirm manifest/worker consistency, read-only status behavior, required
unavailable/broken reasons, prerequisite checks, unrelated-change preservation,
and cleanup/rollback behavior. Do not treat a green CI run as a vehicle test.
